chapter.title: General constraints
chapter.para: These requirements apply to JetOS as a whole.

section.title: SRQ_JET_GEN_001
section.para: JetOS shall provide the same services with the same behaviour on x86_64 and on arm64, except where this document says otherwise.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A partition must not depend on the architecture.

section.title: SRQ_JET_GEN_002
section.para: JetOS shall not use floating point instructions in the kernel itself, so that the floating point state belongs to the partitions alone.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The kernel need not save the state of the unit when it is entered.

section.title: SRQ_JET_GEN_003
section.para: JetOS shall be written for 64-bit processors, with its addresses and sizes held in types that are as wide as the pointers.

section.title: SRQ_JET_GEN_004
section.para: JetOS shall be built as one kernel image that holds the kernel, the configuration, and the images of the partitions, for one board.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The module is loaded in one piece.

section.title: SRQ_JET_GEN_005
section.para: JetOS shall be developed according to the MISRA C:2025 guidelines, with each deviation documented where it is made.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The coding rules are a means to the safety of the code.
